day_shape: Strait of Hormuz dominates: FT reveals four-month covert US mine-clearing op, CENTCOM says 92 vessels redirected, Canada backs US/UK/France coalition, Iran doubles third-tier petrol price, IDF strikes near Nabatieh reportedly kill 9-11.

threads.label: Hormuz coalition and US maritime campaign
threads.summary: Canada publicly backed the US/UK/France effort to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, while the Financial Times reported a covert four-month US Navy SEAL mine-clearing operation and CENTCOM said 92 commercial vessels have been redirected, 3 disabled and 2 boarded. UAE adviser Anwar Gargash said the UAE would not accept any single state's control of the strait.

threads.label: Iran Hormuz threats and nuclear pushback
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri said destabilisation of the Strait of Hormuz was the inevitable result of American actions and warned South Korea of severe fallout if it joined military action there, while Majlis Speaker Qalibaf said US oil and gas assets in the region were vulnerable to retaliation. Bagheri also called an E3 push to refer Iran's nuclear file to the Security Council a breach of agreement, and SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei said a restricted zone would be announced outside the strait.

threads.label: Iran fuel price hike and economic strain
threads.summary: IRIB confirmed the third-tier petrol price at fuel-card pumps will rise to 10,000 tomans from tonight, with first- and second-tier rates unchanged, and Iran International reported the move doubles the non-subsidised price amid fuel shortages. Iran International also published pieces on eggs outpacing cash as a store of value and Majlis energy commission warnings about winter fuel reserves.

threads.label: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF struck Hezbollah sites in southern Lebanon including a command centre in a former hospital building, in response to a Hezbollah drone attack the previous day. Lebanese media reported 9-11 killed and five wounded in overnight strikes on Kfar Reman near Nabatieh, including two children and two paramedics.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire incident and West Bank ops
threads.summary: The IDF said an engineering vehicle hit a Hamas explosive device on the Yellow Line in northern Gaza, calling it a blatant ceasefire violation, and struck Hamas infrastructure in response. Separately, IDF, Shin Bet and Yamam forces apprehended a 10-member Hamas cell near Nablus, recovering a rocket and weapons cache, and killed a knife attacker near Idhna.

threads.label: Regime unity messaging and internal security
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted messages warning against 'phantom duality' framings such as war-or-negotiation and stressing Islamic unity, while the Basij chief rejected negotiations that relinquish rights and the Judiciary head called internal division betrayal. The Intelligence Ministry claimed dismantling three takfiri cells linked to the 'American-Zionist enemy' in Sistan-Baluchistan.

threads.label: Yemen and Houthi activity
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Yemeni government forces made limited gains against the Houthis near the Red Sea and Saudi border, and that the Houthis claimed missile attacks on Saudi-linked vehicles. IRIB claimed Yemen's forces downed three Saudi drones in 24 hours, including a Wing Loong 2.

events.title_en: Hojjat al-Islam Taib: Iranian nation will not tolerate threats and coercion; negotiations at cost of relinquishing people's rights are unacceptable
events.summary_en: Hojjat al-Islam Taib: Iranian nation will not tolerate threats and coercion; negotiations at cost of relinquishing people's rights are unacceptable. Head of the Basij Organisation of the Oppressed, stating that no superpower has the capacity to impose its will on the Iranian nation, said: Negotiations that mean turning a blind eye to the rights of the nation or accepting enemy aggression have no place in Iran's policy. The Iranian nation, just as it has stood in streets and squares, will come to the negotiating table with the same logic of resistance. The Iranian people have repeatedly heard enemy promises and seen their results; therefore, the Islamic Republic of Iran will make decisions based not on promises but on actual actions of the other side.

Secretary of the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution said: Governance in the post-war period differs from the Sacred Defence era and must be managed and designed with precise understanding of societal realities and generational developments. Generational disconnect, certain cultural inclinations among teenagers and young people, and economic challenges are not exclusively Iranian issues and different countries worldwide face similar problems, but the manner of representation and management of these issues in media is different. Today we have new tools such as artificial intelligence, cognitive sciences, quantum technology and social networks at our disposal and we must know how to use them to understand society and solve problems

events.title_en: Grand farewell of people of Tonekabon to body of martyr pilot Soleimzadeh
events.summary_en: Grand farewell of people of Tonekabon to body of martyr pilot Soleimzadeh. The farewell night ceremony for the body of Second Lieutenant pilot martyr Amirhossein Soleimzadeh was held with attendance of officials, families of martyrs and people in Imam Khomeini Square in Tonekabon. The faithful and revolutionary people of Tonekabon, with their massive presence in this ceremony, whilst paying tribute to this honoured martyr, commemorated the memory of martyrs of the nation and renewed their covenant with the ideals of the martyrs. Second Lieutenant pilot martyr Amirhossein Soleimzadeh reached the exalted rank of martyrdom in defence of the Islamic homeland during the enemy American attack on Khorramshahr and ascended to heaven.
